decisions.reason: Steps 1.1 and 2.1 identify natural-log KL mutual information in nats with base-two differential-entropy differences in bits. For independent unit circular Gaussian X,Z, the two quantities are ln(2) and 1, respectively. These are false equalities in the load-bearing degradation argument, a logic defect. Repaired by I(X;BX+Z)=(ln 2)[h(BX+Z)-h(Z)] and by dividing each unconditional and conditional mutual-information term in step 2.1 by ln 2.

reviews.reason: Checked Gaussian smoothing gives bounded joint/marginal/residual densities, finite entropy and positive-definite real covariance, including singular input laws. The density-ratio integral now converts nats to bits explicitly. The degraded Markov chain gives the corrected conditional-information identity; its residual variance is (1-t/s)(1+sp)/(1+tp), and the increasing concave logarithmic ratio gives Jensen under the average variance bound. Independent-user residual variances and their concavity prove every unconditional/genie bound, including reflected cases, zero gains, t=0 and s=t. Clarified F2 conversion and hypotheses and mirrored the repaired steps in the owning contract. Statement unchanged. This is the repair author assessment, not an independent review.
